name: contract-runner-discovery
goal: Discover exact runner case identities and inherited disabled state without inventing group tests

evidence: Discovery treats describe.skip as a case and loses suite-qualified identities. Nested cases can falsely count as enabled coverage or collide across suites.
The existing scan case covered aliases, direct skips and computed registrations only. Strengthened that same case with active and skipped nested describes; suite remains two tests.
Immutable red proof fails the strengthened existing scan case: nested names are unqualified and describe.skip is incorrectly emitted as a case. Two test declarations remain unchanged.
Leaf registrations retain suite-qualified titles and inherited disabled/dynamic flags; group registrations are not invented as tests. The unchanged two-case suite and focused lint pass.
Paired immutable proof passes at dc1e7d5710 after the same two-test suite failed at3479a7da01. Test corpus, command and runtime profile are unchanged.
